Dialogue: All right. Let's give this next job our all, shall we?
Yes, ma'am!
Yes, ma'am!
Absolutely not, ma'am!
Oh?
I wasn't expecting a vicarious vacationer's inspection...
We simply must commemorate this moment!
I have excellent news─they're cultivating Auxesian carrots as we speak!
Splendid! I can't wait to find out how they taste...
Every star has its own unique flavor, after all.
Oh, carrot latte... They could never make me hate you.
How in the hells is this carrot jam so good!?
It's grown surprisingly popular among the initiative.
To think they actually made Archon loaf palatable...
Finally... A break in the action.
We had it rough at the beginning. Glad it's calmed down.
The wealth of flora here delights me so!
Agreed. Auxesia's a botanist's paradise.
There's a new species everywhere you look!
The humidity here is perfect. My skin and hair are thriving!
Indeed. My fur's not felt this moisturized in ages.
I wonder how the tower'll look when it's revitalized...
Keep up the great work, everyone!
Can't forget to record this project for posterity!
The Sprouting Towerling is revivified!
Ta-daaa!
Such mighty-looking machinery!
The path here...
...is now open! Hurrah!
What are those panels surrounding the tower, I wonder...?
The tower must be recorded in its current state!
The Sunning Towerling is revivified!
And we're beaming with joy!
My word! Are we launching all of those?
Engineers, prepare your drones!
The path to the Rooting Towerling is secured!
We've done it!
What purpose did this tower serve...?
The bright flash of our passion pierces the darkness!
The Rooting Towerling is back in action!
Huzzah, huzzah!

Zzzzzz...
So warm and cozy...

Bwahahaha!
The Emerald Star is mine!

Yes, just like that!
The backdrop is perfect!
Phew! Glad I made it in time!
It all makes sense now...
You! Get down from there this instant!
Ahhh... Nothing beats that first, blissful sip.
I wonder if he ever wanted to travel the cosmos...
Who? Oh, your Turali colleague?
I trust your friend is docile?
A beastmaster!?
How much for the beastie, eh?
Greetings, beastmaster.
Take care your pet doesn't stray.
What a fine beast!
Taking your familiar on a stroll?
Feels like everyone's got a beast these days...
I reckon you two could take on any pirate.
It'll be a good haul today, I can feel it.
I wonder, what fish will preserve well enough to take back for Nidhana...
This machina will be a great boon to our efforts on the star...
I know we said vacation, but these are the ideal conditions for measuring heat resistance... Just a few tests!
What a beautiful piece. Let's go with it, kweh...
